messages:
jules: Quick latch-thread 1 - PM asks for a tiny, unambiguous sprint gate for enterprise compliance work (audit exports, BYOK handshake, KMS rotation, retention). Need artifacts that CI/legal can verify automatically.

rachel: Love the "latch" idea. Keep checklist to 5-7 pass/fail items that produce files/logs.

tom: Draft checklist below. Each item should produce one artifact: either a signed file, a log entry, or a smoke-test exit code.

```
- export_sample: ndjson export for 7-day window -> export.ndjson + export.sha256
- signed_manifest: manifest.json + manifest.sig (service-signer key-id: svc-sign-v1)
- byok_roundtrip: export+wipe+restore using customer key in sandbox -> restore.log
- kms_rotation: rotate staging key -> decrypt-verify.log (auto+manual path tested)
- retention_ttl_check: TTL enforcement smoke in primary+DR -> ttl_report.json
- soc2_artifacts: 2 evidence packs with retrieval.log entries
```

opsbot: Note: retention bucket change requires metadata backfill. Plan a short backfill during canary. Playbook: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/retention-migration>.

legal_tom: Contract notes: require 30d notice for retention >90d, escrow acceptance requires signed_manifest + verifier logs and hash verification steps. I'll post PR with exact wording.

rachel: Who signs manifest? Ops-managed signing service with auditable key id (svc-sign-v1). Public key published in docs.

jules: RTO/RPO numbers for the acceptance doc: hot RTO=15m/RPO=30s, warm RTO=6h/RPO=5m, cold RTO=48h/RPO=1h. Add them to the doc.

tom: Example smoke curl to add to CI job (outputs artifacts above):

curl -sS -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/audit/export -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"t-sandbox","from":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z","to":"2026-09-07T00:00:00Z","format":"ndjson"}' | tee export.ndjson && sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256 && ./sign-manifest --key /opt/signing/svc-sign-v1.key export.sha256 > manifest.sig

opsbot: Also: cross-region replication must enforce TTLs consistently. File infra ticket to validate replication retention enforcement.

rachel: Action owners: tom -> export tool + byok roundtrip; ops -> signer svc + rotation runbook; legal_tom -> contract PR; jules -> acceptance doc + CI harness.

jules: Timeline: spikes this sprint; run artifacts on dev/staging/customer-sandbox next week. If all artifacts present and checksums/manifests validate, PM will flip gate to READY.

rachel: Will publish the latch checklist once smoke logs are attached. :white_check_mark:

jules: Thanks all. Please post any failing logs here so we can triage quickly.
